visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two finished loaves of crusty, artisanal bread sit on a metal cooling rack against a bright window backdrop. A hand enters the frame briefly to adjust them. The lighting is soft and natural, emphasizing the texture of the crust. (2) A close-up shot focuses on dark, plump raisins being strained in a silver mesh sieve over a kitchen counter. The raisins appear glistening and moist, ready for use in baking. (3) A white stand mixer is seen from a medium close-up angle, actively kneading a pale, elastic dough in a stainless steel bowl. Fine water droplets or condensation are visible on the exterior of the bowl. (4) In an overhead shot, a large mass of dough is divided into several uneven chunks inside a silver mixing bowl, with dark raisins scattered haphazardly across the surface of the pieces. (5) The stand mixer resumes its operation, with the raisins now being rhythmically incorporated into the swirling, pale dough. The movement is consistent and efficient, ensuring even distribution. (6) Hands work on a clean white marble surface, dividing the risen dough with a plastic scraper and rolling them into small, smooth rounds. A digital scale is visible in the background. (7) A pair of hands rolls out a piece of dough with a heavy marble rolling pin on the countertop, then carefully rolls it up into a long cylinder, tapering the ends. (8) Two tapered dough loaves are placed on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. They have significantly expanded in size, indicating the completion of the final proofing stage. (9) A hand sprays a fine mist of water onto the dough loaves, then dusts them with white flour using a small sieve. A thin blade is then used to score decorative lines. (10) A pair of silver scissors is used to precisely snip a specific raisin that is protruding from a scored line on the dough's surface to prevent burning. (11) The loaves are seen through the glass door of a modern oven, baking on two wire racks under warm, orange internal lighting. (12) The finished, golden-brown loaves are placed back on a wire cooling rack. They feature distinct flour-dusted patterns and deep, attractive scores from the baking process. (13) A finger gently touches the crispy, flaky surface of one bread loaf, demonstrating the crunchy texture of the crust in a well-lit indoor environment. (14) A hand picks up one of the finished loaves, showing its substantial weight and solid, well-baked structure. The background is a slightly blurred kitchen setting. (15) The finger points out specific details and textures of the golden crust again, emphasizing the successful result of the raisin bread recipe.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: LAMASHANIA. [Subtitle]: 有葡萄乾的麵包要注意什麼?. (2) [Subtitle]: 懶人法 葡萄乾先過水再瀝乾. (3) [Subtitle]: 讓葡萄乾有點水分 才不會把麵團水分吸走. (4) [Subtitle]: 放葡萄乾之前 把麵團分成幾塊. (5) [Subtitle]: 像這樣. (6) [Subtitle]: 葡萄乾會更快分布均勻在麵團裡. (7) [Subtitle]: 發酵好之後 分割 滾圓. (8) [Subtitle]: 往中間壓 麵團中間可以鼓鼓的. (9) [Subtitle]: 把上下搓細一點. (10) [Subtitle]: 最終發酵完成. (11) [Subtitle]: 噴水 灑粉 割線. (12) [Subtitle]: 遇到葡萄乾 用「剪刀」剪開. (13) [Subtitle]: 我喜歡這邊酥酥的. (14) [Subtitle]: 有葡萄乾的麵包就是好吃. (15) [Subtitle]: 配方在留言區.
